record.title: GUI-burst write to /home/desktop/.config/autostart is invisible to gui_changes, persists into later snapshots, and re-executes as uid 1001 after a human restore
record.description: The agent's GUI tools (key/type, no approval gate by design) drive an xfce4-terminal that runs as uid 1001 `desktop`. From that terminal the agent can write ~/.config/autostart/*.desktop. The burst change tracking (`workspace_manifest`, `gui_changes`) only scans /workspace, and stray-kill only stops processes, so an inert file under /home/desktop is neither recorded nor removed. The burst-open snapshot predates the write and stays clean. A later `docker commit` captures the file: the next burst's `next_burst` snapshot, an AP-2 pre-snapshot, an interval snapshot, or a manual snapshot. When a human restores to such a snapshot, `restore()` recreates the container from the committed image and re-runs `agentbox-desktop-start`, which execs `startxfce4` as uid 1001. XFCE runs the autostart entry's Exec= line at session start. The command runs as uid 1001 with a live X session and /workspace write access (group agent), outside any GUI burst. No `gui_changes` or `gui_processes_stopped` event records it, and `gui_strays` would exempt it anyway because it is in the next burst's baseline. The decisive end-to-end reproduction is the parent's live run against the real desktop image (`agents/parent-live/artifacts/l12_autostart.py` and `.out`). I could not run Docker, so I did not redo it; I re-read the script and it exercises the claimed path. The hunter's three blockers are resolved by that run. The hunter's 'restart' variant is not supported by the source: the only recreate path is the human-only `POST /sandboxes/{sid}/restore`, and pause/unpause keeps processes. The finding therefore covers restore only.
record.root_cause: GUI-burst containment is scoped to /workspace and to running processes. `workspace_manifest` runs `find /workspace -xdev`. `_close_gui_burst` diffs only that manifest and `gui_strays` only kills processes. The burst principal (uid 1001) also owns /home/desktop, and the XFCE session re-reads ~/.config/autostart on every container start. Nothing captures, flags, or sanitizes /home/desktop between the burst, the `docker commit`, and the restore re-exec. Restore reintroduces the executable state without re-authorization or logging.
record.intended_behavior: Changes an agent makes through the GUI are meant to be visible to the human (`gui_changes`) or contained by stray-kill, so a restore point is trustworthy. Restoring a snapshot should not silently re-run agent-planted code outside a burst.

trace.scope: SandboxService tool dispatch for GUI_TOOLS (key/type, GUI_INPUT)
trace.description: The agent token reaches GUI input with no approval. It opens an xfce4-terminal as uid 1001 and writes ~/.config/autostart/t.desktop. The live run used key ctrl+alt+t, type, and key Return, and all three returned 200.
The burst records only `workspace_manifest` plus the baseline pids. The burst-open snapshot is taken before the write, so it does not contain the payload.
The manifest `find` is limited to /workspace (-xdev), so a file under /home/desktop never enters the diff.

`diff_manifest` runs over the /workspace-only manifest and `_stop_gui_strays` only kills processes. No gui_changes or gui_processes_stopped event is written for the autostart file. The live run printed 'gui_changes mention /home/desktop: False'.
`c.commit(...)` captures the whole container filesystem, including /home/desktop/.config/autostart. The live run took a manual snapshot after the burst closed.

Restore recreates the container from the committed image and re-runs the template command `/usr/local/bin/agentbox-desktop-start` (config.py:74). That script execs `dbus-launch ... startxfce4` as uid 1001 (agentbox-desktop-start:30). XFCE autostart then runs the planted Exec= line. Live result: PROOF_autostart.txt appeared in /workspace with content 1001.

evidence.description: `find {WORKSPACE} -xdev ! -type d` is the only change manifest. Nothing under /home is scanned.
The `gui_changes` diff is computed only over that manifest. There is no hook for /home/desktop.

`gui_strays` skips pids already in the baseline and only ever returns pids, so it cannot remove a file. A payload launched at container boot is in the next burst's baseline. The hunter's harness agents/h-autostart/artifacts/h.out shows `[]` for the baseline case and `[200]` for the in-burst case.
The commit captures the full filesystem, so the payload persists into every later snapshot.
Restore reruns the template command on the committed image.
The desktop template command is the XFCE start script.
The script runs `startxfce4` as uid 1001 with HOME=/home/desktop on every container start.
uid 1001 `desktop` owns /home/desktop (mode 700, line 28). Only this principal can write there; the uid 1000 agent cannot, so the GUI path is required.

Parent-live output against the real image. Agent GUI tools created t.desktop (observed by root). No gui_changes or gui_processes_stopped event named /home/desktop. After snapshot and human restore, PROOF_autostart.txt appeared with content 1001.

conditions.description: An agent token with GUI tools on a desktop-template sandbox, assumed prompt-injected.

A human must restore to a snapshot taken after the write. The burst-open snapshot of the writing burst is clean. Later snapshots (next_burst, AP-2, interval, manual) carry the file, and no audit event warns that they do.
The desktop image's XFCE session honours ~/.config/autostart, which the live run confirmed. The container has network_mode none and the sandbox boundary is not crossed.

execution.attacker_perspective: A prompt-injected agent holding only its own agt_ token and the GUI tools on a desktop sandbox.
instructions: Create a disposable desktop sandbox with dummy tokens and a scratch AGENTBOX_HOME.
As the agent, call the key, type, and key tools with the payloads above.
Close the burst (idle) and confirm the audit log has no gui_changes or gui_processes_stopped entry naming /home/desktop.
Take a snapshot after the burst, then run the human POST /sandboxes/{sid}/restore for that snapshot.
Wait for the display and check that /workspace/PROOF_autostart.txt exists. Stop there.
This is reproduced by agents/parent-live/artifacts/l12_autostart.py and .out, the parent's run on the real image. Docker was not available to v19.
execution.observed_result: The parent-live run printed: agent key/type/key all 200; root observer saw t.desktop; PROOF before restore False; gui_changes mention /home/desktop False; human snapshot snap_9051d98e; restore running; PROOF after restore (autostart re-executed) True; PROOF content (uid) 1001; no gui_changes or gui_processes_stopped events in the audit trail.

remediation.strategy: Treat /home/desktop as part of the GUI-burst change surface and neutralize it at restore. At burst close, also manifest-diff the persistent session config (/home/desktop/.config/autostart, ~/.config/xfce4, shell rc files, /etc/xdg/autostart) and log changes. At restore and start, the start script should wipe or reset ~/.config/autostart and similar session-startup paths (or use an XDG_CONFIG_DIRS/autostart-free profile) before launching startxfce4. Alternatively mount /home/desktop as tmpfs, or recreate it from the pristine image skeleton on each start, so agent-written session state cannot survive a snapshot.

code_changes.fixed_code:
# before launching startxfce4 (as root, before as_desktop ... startxfce4):
rm -rf "$D/.config/autostart" "$D/.config/xfce4/xfconf/xfce-perchannel-xml/xfce4-session.xml" "$D/.bashrc" "$D/.profile" "$D/.bash_profile" "$D/.xprofile" "$D/.xsessionrc"
# plus log a gui_changes-style diff of these paths at burst close in agentbox/sandbox.py

likelihood.reason: Needs a prompt-injected agent with GUI tools on a desktop sandbox, and a human restore to a snapshot taken after the write. The restore is human-only and the burst-open snapshot of the writing burst is clean. The control plane has no restart path other than restore.

impact.reason: Re-executes agent-chosen commands as uid 1001 inside a network-none, cap-dropped container. Those commands could already run during the GUI burst, since GUI input is ungated by design. The gain is unlogged, post-restore execution that defeats gui_changes, stray-kill, and the trust placed in restore points. It crosses neither the container boundary nor the approval authority.

confidence.reason: Every trace line was re-read in the audited source. The hunter's local harness shows the baseline exemption. The parent-live run on the real image shows the full chain: agent GUI write, no audit record, snapshot, human restore, uid 1001 execution. The decisive reproduction is the parent's, not v19's, because v19 cannot run Docker. The 'restart' variant from the hunter is not supported by the source and is dropped.
